integrity: Rational point-orbit and exact matrix-product checks were performed with package code. The proof is general in n; checks through n=11 alone are not exhaustive. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for dimension two, iterate-fixed-point counting excluding the fixed face; does not cover least-period-only samples or higher dimensions. Published symbolic coding and no-periodic-boundary-points theorem are used. Priority uncertainty: unindexed derivations from signed monomial matrices could reproduce the joint law.
title: Matched spectral classes at every singular-gap level in the two-dimensional twisted baker map
